sentences.text: Coram:- Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Kuldeep Tiwari

Present: Mr. Amrsh Dudeja, Advocate for
 Mr. Varun Sharma, Advocate for the petitioner.
 Mr. Sahil R. Bakshi, Aag, Punjab.
Ms. Darika Sikka, Advocate for respondent no.2.

The present petition has been filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C for issuing appropriate direction to respondent No.1 to properly investigate the criminal case and take action on the FIR No.180 dated 10.05.2017 under Sections 406, 420, 120-B IPC registered at Police Station Bhupani, District Faridabad.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner at the very outset submits that in the instant case, the investigation is already completed, and on the basis of compromise, the prosecution proceeded to file a cancellation report, which is pending consideration before the learned Illaqa Magistrate concerned.

However, he further submits that the grievance of the petitioner still survives as respondent no.2/accused did not adhere to the directions and conditions of the compromise, which they have entered into.
He further submits that he want to reserve his rights to raise his grievance before the learned Illaqa Magistrate concerned, by resorting to the apt provisions of law.
1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:147440 3. The above said request made by learned counsel for the petitioner seems bona fide and the same is accepted.
